notes.summary: A Nether forest of red fungi and hungry Piglins. Fire, Grass and Poison thrive; ice and water do not. Attacking first is risky and winning fights is rewarded.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Fire, Grass and Poison moves are 1.3× stronger. Special Bug moves are 1.2× stronger.
Water moves are 0.8× and Ice moves are 0.5×.

Special Flying moves also count as Poison when working out type effectiveness. Power Whip and Vine Whip also count as Fire and are 1.5× stronger on top of the Grass bonus (1.95× in total). Slash, Air Slash, Fury Cutter, Air Cutter, Psycho Cut, Breaking Swipe and Cut gain the Grass type as in the Forest.
Extra types change damage only; they never add same-type bonus.
Pay Day is 1.5× stronger and Make It Rain is 1.3× stronger.

Acid Spray, Clear Smog and Smog are 1.5× stronger (1.95× with the Poison bonus). Barb Barrage and Venoshock always deal their doubled damage. Toxic and Will-O-Wisp have 100% accuracy. Fire Spin deals 1/6 of maximum HP each turn.
Mimicry, Camouflage and Terrain Pulse use the Fire type. Nature Power becomes Power Whip. Secret Power can burn. Shelter halves Fire damage to its user.

sections.heading: Piglin Bloodlust
lines: When a Pokémon directly knocks out an opposing Pokémon with a move, its Attack rises by 1 stage. This stacks with Moxie.
A move that knocks out two opposing Pokémon at once gives +2. Knockouts from poison, burns, weather, recoil, field damage or your own ally do not count.

sections.heading: Crimson Vines
lines: Damaging moves with positive priority have their final accuracy multiplied by 0.8. Moves that never miss are not affected.
If the move misses because of this penalty, the user crashes like High Jump Kick and loses half its maximum HP. Ordinary misses, Protect and immunity never cause a crash.

sections.heading: Piglins and gold
lines: A Pokémon with Good as Gold gains +1 Speed and +1 Special Attack when it enters.

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Hail and Snow melt away as soon as they appear. Pokémon cannot be frozen.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Grass Pelt, Leaf Guard, Overgrow and Swarm are active. Effect Spore triggers 60% of the time.
Merciless, Poison Heal and Toxic Boost are active as in Corrosive Mist.
Grounded Flash Fire users power up at the end of each turn, and grounded Well-Baked Body users gain +1 Defense. Steam Engine can gain Speed each turn.
Magma Armor raises Defense by 1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Elemental Seed
lines: Attack +1, Special Attack +1, Speed +1, then the holder is taunted.
